items.title: Microsoft and organizations across industries launch AI Transparency Initiative to strengthen enterprise trust in AI models and agents
items.summary: Organizations can observe much of the activity around AI models, but they often cannot reconstruct what happened between a request and an outcome, making it difficult to independently verify model behavior. At Microsoft Ignite on Tuesday, Microsoft Chairman and CEO Satya Nadella announced the next phase of Microsoft's commitment to making AI safer: the AI Transparency Initiative, a collaborative effort with customers and partners to establish a common, open approach to security and governance ac
